data.title: Utgard 2018 – a great battle at an early medieval festival
data.excerpt: The main attractions of Utgard 2018 undoubtedly included the great battle of all the male participants of this fine festival of the Early Middle Ages. We bring you one of the clashes of that merciless battle.
data.metaTitle: Utgard 2018 – festival of the Early Middle Ages
data.metaDescription: From Utgard 2018, a festival of the Early Middle Ages whose main attraction was the great battle of all the male participants of the event.

mediaTexts.caption: Hillforts were of course not missing from one of the best events devoted to the Early Middle Ages. Here in a discussion with Dr Ján Steinhubel and Dr Rastislav Kožiak
